user.title: Set up GL.iNet router
user.description: Enter the router's management address and password. If Home Assistant can't reach the router's LAN side directly (e.g. it's behind its own NAT), use whatever address is reachable from this network (such as its WAN IP) and enable HTTPS if needed. A pasted web address such as https://192.168.8.1/ is fine.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The router at {host} rejected the stored username or password (was the password changed?). Enter the current ones.

reconfigure.title: Change the settings of {name}
reconfigure.description: Change the address, protocol or login of this router. Leave the password empty to keep the current one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the router

abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different router than the one being changed

add_static_ip.name: Add static IP
add_static_ip.description: Set a DHCP static lease (fixed IP) for a device.

remove_static_ip.name: Remove static IP
remove_static_ip.description: Remove a device's DHCP static lease.

init.title: WOOW GL.iNet options
init.description: Show Wi-Fi passwords as the state of their text entities. Anyone who can see entity states can then read them, and they are kept in the history database. The sidebar panel does not need this.

data.expose_wifi_passwords: Show Wi-Fi passwords as entity states
